g.text: Input-only example: largest seed fraction among non-fragment sources; WT SHA tie-break.
Proposal above: Policy = selected winner; Uniform = not selected. No outcome-based choice.
Both arms: 22 shared seed residues + 8 completion residues = 30 deletions.
Rows 01-20: paired final winners; full WT IDs in source data. Grey row: mean and CI.
Local: 4 improve / 1 degrade / 15 tie. Contacts: 5 improve / 0 degrade / 15 tie.
N = 20 WT / components; original bootstrap 10,000, seed 20261016. Unitless common endpoints.
Orange = shared homolog seed; teal = Policy; dark grey = Uniform. Both share frozen Scorer / K8.
